author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Radxa has unveiled the Linkr, a compact remote-control device for accessing computers, servers, and development boards through a web browser. The unit combines HDMI video capture with USB keyboard and mouse emulation, allowing users to view and operate a target system without connecting a dedicated monitor, keyboard, or mouse. title: Radxa Linkr Brings Remote KVM Access and Tailscale Support to a Thumb-Sized Device

author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: First seen in March, Brisbane Silicon has now launched the ELM11-Feather to Crowd Supply. Priced at $39, the Feather-compatible development board combines native Lua support with the Arvore IDE and a configurable hardware architecture programmable in C, SystemVerilog, and VHDL. The board uses a GOWIN GW1NR9-C FPGA with approximately 8K LUTs. Its default hardware overlay […]
title: ELM11-Feather Debuts with Native Lua and Reconfigurable FPGA Hardware
